name: dex
description: Read-only Dex context and safety tools for Claude Desktop.
long_description: Bring Dex's daily context, person context, harness catalogue, and safety checks into Claude Desktop without giving the extension write access.

tools.name: ask_what_was_decided
tools.description: Answer what was decided about a topic, or lately with no topic, from this Dex folder's own decision record.

tools.name: ask_what_is_still_open_with_people
tools.description: List every unchecked to-do from person pages, each naming the person and the page. Honest sentence if none.

tools.name: ask_who_is_in_todays_plan
tools.description: Answer who is in today's plan: each named person's recorded role, company, last interaction, and every open item, each row naming the person page, in plan order. Missing field empty, never guessed.

tools.name: ask_who_is_named_in_note
tools.description: Answer who is named in one note inside this Dex folder: each named person's recorded role, company, last interaction, and every open item, each row naming the person page, in the note's own order. Missing fields stay empty, never guessed. Refuses paths outside the folder.

tools.name: ask_what_is_still_open_in_note
tools.description: Answer what is still open in one note inside this Dex folder: every unchecked to-do written in that note, in the note's own order. Not the open items on person pages. Refuses paths outside the folder.

tools.name: check_safety_gate
tools.description: Check a proposed command or path.

vault_path.title: Dex folder
vault_path.description: Choose the root folder containing your Dex system.
